reasoning: Washington, D.C. does not have a U.S. Senate seat, and it does not vote in presidential elections, so there is no current Senate or presidential race margin to report for the District. The relevant structural measure is its Cook Partisan Voting Index, which is overwhelmingly Democratic; because no state-specific current-race polling exists here, all race-specific sources would be other_context only.
